comparison.objective: Insert an emergency-stop button through a keyed panel hole and secure it with a rear locking ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed insertion, front-side stabilization, and coordinated rear-side threading.
comparison.success_condition: Button seated flush with tab in notch; ring tightened to its specified turn and gap; assembly released and still.
comparison.reason: This is a plausible alignment neighbor, but its tested outcome is keyed seating and threaded retention. It lacks interface-continuous transfer and the catastrophic loose-ball-loss mode central to the candidate.
